teaser.en: Its leaves go slippery when crushed, and they are rubbed on beads to clean them.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na husuguliwa kwenye shanga ili kuzisafisha.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala na uhereza, na ushanga nkusingwa kpwa makodza higa ili kuutsusa.

summary.en: Mnyururika is a small, velvety, grey-leaved herb with dense clusters of tiny yellow flowers. Its leaves are crushed for medicine and used to clean beads.
summary.sw: Mnyururika ni mmea mdogo wa majani ya kijivu yenye manyoya laini kama mahameli, wenye vishada vizito vya maua madogo sana ya manjano. Majani yake hupondwa kwa ajili ya dawa na hutumika kusafisha shanga.
summary.dg: *Mnyururika* ni mmea mdide wenye makodza ga rangi ya ivu genye nyere laini, na mabunda ga kubanana ga maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya mandano. Makodzage nkuhopezwa kpwa dawa, na nkuhumirwa kutsusa ushanga.

about.en:
*Mnyururika* is a small, much-branched herb or low shrub, usually knee-high or less. Its stems and leaves are covered in soft, greyish, velvety hairs. The leaves are oval, toothed and pleated along their veins. Tiny bright yellow flowers grow in dense, rounded clusters at the leaf bases.

When the leaves are crushed they give a slippery juice, which is behind one of its Digo names.
about.sw:
*Mnyururika* ni mmea mdogo wenye matawi mengi au kichaka kifupi, kwa kawaida chenye urefu wa goti au chini ya hapo. Mashina na majani yake yamefunikwa na manyoya laini ya rangi ya kijivu yaliyo kama mahameli. Majani ni ya duaradufu, yenye meno kwenye kingo na yenye mikunjo kufuata mishipa yake. Maua madogo sana ya manjano angavu huota katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye vishina vya majani.

Majani yakipondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza, na hilo ndilo chanzo cha mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.
about.dg:
*Mnyururika* ni mmea mdide wenye panda nyinji, au chitsaka chifupi, na kpwa kawaida tautsupa ure wa goti. Pandaze na makodzage vinafwinikpwa ni nyere laini za rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu. Makodza ni ga umbo ra tumbi, gana meno kanda-kanda, na ganakala na mikunjo kulunga mishipaye. Maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kubanana ga mviringo, phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda.

Makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi genye uhereza, na hiro ndiro dzambo ririrolavya dzina mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo.

where.en: It is a weed of roadsides, fallow land, grassland and disturbed sandy ground. It is found throughout the tropics, and is common along the coast.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kando ya barabara, mashamba yaliyoachwa, nyika za nyasi na ardhi ya mchanga iliyochimbuliwa. Unapatikana kote katika nchi za tropiki, na ni wa kawaida kando ya pwani.
where.dg: Ni mbondo inayomera kanda-kanda ya njira, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, herera za nyasi na tsi ya mtsanga iriyobanangwa. Inaphahikana kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho, na ni ya kawaida pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are squashed and used as medicine. They are also used to clean beads (*tsalu*). The plant is a well-known medicinal herb in many tropical countries.
uses.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba majani hupondwa na kutumika kama dawa. Pia hutumika kusafisha shanga (*tsalu*). Mmea huu ni dawa ya mitishamba inayojulikana sana katika nchi nyingi za tropiki.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodza nkuhopezwa na kuhumirwa dza dawa. Piya nkuhumirwa kutsusa ushanga (*tsalu*). Kpwenye tsi nyinji za dzoho, mmea uhu ni dawa ya chienyeji inayomanyikana sana.

names.en: Pakia gives two names. *Mnyururika* means 'slippery extract': the crushed leaves give a slippery (*nyururika*) juice. *Mtsusa tsalu* means 'cleaning beads': the leaves are used for cleaning (*tsusa*) beads (*tsalu*). The Mgombato dictionary defines *tsalu* as 'beads decorating the edge of a piece of cloth'. Pakia uses both names for *Triumfetta rhomboidea* as well, and *mtsusa tsalu* also for *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. 'Sleepy morning' is an English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa majina mawili. *Mnyururika* maana yake ni 'ute unaoteleza': majani yaliyopondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza (*nyururika*). *Mtsusa tsalu* maana yake ni 'kusafisha shanga': majani hutumika kusafisha (*tsusa*) shanga (*tsalu*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inafasili *tsalu* kuwa 'shanga zinazopamba ukingo wa kipande cha nguo'. Pakia hutumia majina yote mawili pia kwa *Triumfetta rhomboidea*, na *mtsusa tsalu* pia kwa *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa *sleepy morning*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Pakia analavya madzina mairi. Mana ya *mnyururika* ni 'madzi genye uhereza': makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi ga uhereza (*nyururika*). Mana ya *mtsusa tsalu* ni 'unaotsusa ushanga': makodza nkuhumirwa kutsusa (*tsusa*) ushanga (*tsalu*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *tsalu* kukala ni 'ushanga unaoikpwa kanda-kanda ya chipande cha nguwo'. Pakia anahumira madzina higa mairi piya kpwa *Triumfetta rhomboidea*, na *mtsusa tsalu* piya kpwa *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Kpwa Chingereza aina ihi inaihwa *sleepy morning*, ela dzina hiri Pakia kariandika.
